item.title: CBFC makes subtitles mandatory for all Indian films from March 15
item.description: In a move aimed at making the movie-going experience more inclusive, the Central Board of Film Certification has made subtitles mandatory for films across languages. The CBFC’s directive will come into effect from March 15, 2026.
